note: Fixtures 650-670 and png were generated by small programs kept in an earlier scratch workspace; those programs were lost with that workspace and are described here so they can be recreated. From v1.8.3 the fixtures are made by tools/art-harness (kept in the repository): Fixtures.java writes each project with the IDE's own project classes and Main.java runs the DesignActivity Run-build steps on the Android 12 (API 31) ART runtime that setup-art.sh installs, with the classes and the x86_64 aapt2 inside the built IDE APK. #644, #623 and #606 are the owner's phone projects: they are not in the workspace; fixtures 905/660/png reproduce their failure kinds. v1.8.4 adds 908 (m3), 909 (telugu, fonts from tools/art-harness/make-test-fonts.py), the export-AAB command (run.sh <apk> <root> aab <id>), layoutlib renders in a separate Paparazzi module (described in v1.8.4-verification.md) and the aapt2 ABI comparison (tools/aapt2-static/compare-abis.sh).
